title: Investigations into Cyberattack on MINDEF's Systems
what_it_is: Investigations into Cyberattack on MINDEF's Systems

sections.label: MINDEF I-net breach detection
sections.summary: MINDEF's I-net breach was detected on 1 February 2017, the affected server was taken offline, and forensics showed it occurred weeks earlier.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: The breach of MINDEF's I-net system was detected on 1 February 2017 and the affected server was taken offline.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: Forensic investigations on the I-net system showed that the breach had occurred weeks before detection.

sections.label: Agencies informed, personnel contacted
sections.summary: Other Government agencies were informed, the 854 affected personnel were contacted, and MINDEF/SAF will develop tools to enhance cyberattack response.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: Other relevant Government agencies were also informed about the breach, and the 854 personnel, whose personal information was stolen, were contacted to take the necessary precautions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: As part of ongoing initiatives to strengthen our cyber systems, MINDEF/SAF will develop better assessment tools, data analytics and content scanning engines to enhance our response to cyberattacks.

sections.label: Mitigation steps and lost information
sections.summary: MINDEF declined to comment on identifying the perpetrator, and stated that only NRIC, telephone numbers and dates of birth were lost, with no passwords.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: If so, has MINDEF taken any steps to mitigate this?

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: I have to seek the Member's understanding that because this concerns a security issue, I would rather not comment about how we have identified the perpetrator and who it can be or who it is.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: For the second question, the information lost is basic, which are National Registration Identity Card, telephone numbers and dates of birth.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: No passwords were lost and I do not think that with this information, they can conduct further hacking.
